title: The allocation problem
text: You have fifty lakh rupees for marketing next month. Where should it go? Mosaic Mix Lab helps you explore that decision.

title: Complete official data
text: We process all ten thousand, nine hundred and fifty official records. Every record passes validation. Email, SMS, and Affiliate have the highest average returns.

title: The proportional baseline
text: The brief suggests allocating in proportion to average returns. This gives expected revenue of about two point six six crore rupees. The exact amount is on screen.

title: The mathematical maximum
text: But the mathematical maximum is different: fifteen lakh to Email, twelve lakh to SMS, and twenty-three lakh to Affiliate. With constant returns, expected revenue reaches about three point three nine crore.

title: Patterns and model limits
text: Real returns can change. For Meta Ads, returns fall sharply as spend increases. These charts show why historical averages need careful interpretation.

title: Trace every observation
text: Every result has evidence. Search by date, filter by channel, or sort by spend. Here, we find Email on January first, twenty twenty-three.

title: An auditable record
text: Open the row to compare spend, revenue, and the calculated amount. This difference comes from rounding, not an overcharge. The explanation and original values are downloadable.

title: Reproducible and explicit
text: The methodology explains both strategies and their rounding adjustments. Two independent implementations reproduce the answers. You get a plan you can explore, with evidence you can check. No application has been submitted.
